links.outcome: Readability of LLM answers to cirrhosis questions (Flesch-Kincaid)
links.effect: Readability of all four LLMs was generally low, requiring a college-level reading comprehension ability; models could simplify complex information when asked.
links.quote: While the readability of all four LLMs was generally low, requiring a college-level reading comprehension ability, they exhibited strong capabilities in simplifying complex information.

links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM answers to cirrhosis questions by consensus scoring
links.effect: ChatGPT 'Good' accuracy rating 80%, Claude 72%, Gemini 49%, Llama 64%.
links.quote: ChatGPT performed best in terms of accuracy, with a "Good" rating of 80%, higher than Claude (72%), Gemini (49%), and Llama (64%).
